quote: **Config:** `config/configuration.ts` is the single place all env vars are read. Returns a typed `ConfigType`. Uses `@nestjs/config` (global).
statement: In src/server/**, code must not read process.env directly outside src/server/config/configuration.ts; configuration must be obtained through the typed ConfigType via @nestjs/config.

quote: **`api/`** — GraphQL resolvers organized by domain. Each subdomain (channels, invoices, wallet, boltz, amboss, etc.) has `*.module.ts`, `*.resolver.ts`, `*.types.ts`, and optionally `*.helpers.ts`.
statement: In src/server/modules/api/<domain>/, each GraphQL subdomain must consist of <domain>.module.ts, <domain>.resolver.ts, <domain>.types.ts and optionally <domain>.helpers.ts.

quote: **`node/`** — LND abstraction layer. `NodeService` is the facade resolvers call; it resolves the account by user ID, then delegates to `LndService`.
statement: In src/server/modules/api/** resolvers, code must call NodeService (the facade) and must not call LndService or other provider services directly.

quote: `LndService` wraps the `lightning` npm package directly.
statement: In src/server/**, the `lightning` npm package should be imported and called only by LndService (src/server/modules/node/lnd/**), not by resolvers or other modules.

quote: Key decorators: `@Public()` (skip auth), `@Roles(...)`, `@CurrentUser()` (extracts `UserId` from GQL context).
statement: In src/server/** resolvers, unauthenticated endpoints must be marked with @Public(), role restrictions with @Roles(...), and the current user must be obtained via the @CurrentUser() parameter decorator rather than reading the GQL context manually.

quote:
→ Resolver receives @CurrentUser() with { id: accountHash }
  → Resolver calls NodeService.method(user.id, ...)
statement: In src/server/modules/api/** resolvers, calls to NodeService methods must pass the current user's id (user.id from @CurrentUser()) as the first argument.

quote: **`fetch/`** — HTTP client with optional SOCKS proxy (Tor) support. `graphqlFetchWithProxy()` for external GraphQL APIs.
statement: In src/server/**, requests to external GraphQL APIs should go through graphqlFetchWithProxy() from the fetch module rather than raw fetch/HTTP clients, so SOCKS/Tor proxy settings apply.

quote: The `lightning` library returns errors as arrays `[title, string, { err }]`; `lnd.helpers.ts` has a dedicated `to()` that transforms these.
statement: In src/server/modules/node/lnd/**, errors from the `lightning` library must be transformed by the to() helper in lnd.helpers.ts rather than handled as raw arrays.

quote: Use `toWithError<T>(promise)` (from `utils/async.ts`) for LND calls that may fail — returns `[data, undefined] | [undefined, error]`. Use `to<T>(promise)` when you want to throw on error.
statement: In src/server/**, LND calls that may fail must be wrapped with toWithError<T>(promise) from utils/async.ts (destructuring [data, error]), or with to<T>(promise) when the error should be thrown.
scope: src/server/** services and resolvers calling LND

quote: The `lightning` library errors are arrays; use the dedicated `to()` in `lnd.helpers.ts` (not the generic one) when wrapping raw `lnd` calls.
statement: In src/server/**, raw `lightning` library calls on an lnd handle must be wrapped with the to() exported from lnd.helpers.ts, not the generic to() from utils/async.ts.

quote: Tests are co-located as `*.spec.ts` next to the file under test.
statement: In src/server/**, unit tests must be named *.spec.ts and placed in the same directory as the file under test.

quote: New UI components must use **shadcn/ui** (New York style).
statement: In src/client/src/**, new UI components must be built with shadcn/ui (New York style) primitives.

quote: Do not add new styled-components.
statement: In src/client/src/**, code must not add new styled-components (styled.x`...` definitions); use shadcn/ui and Tailwind instead.

quote: Use the `@/` import alias for all client-side imports (maps to `src/client/src/`).
statement: In src/client/src/**, imports of client modules must use the @/ path alias rather than relative paths.

quote: Follow the dual-context pattern (`useXState()` / `useXDispatch()`) for new shared state.
statement: In src/client/src/**, new shared state must be implemented as two React contexts (state and dispatch) exposed through useXState() and useXDispatch() custom hooks.

quote: Icons: use **Lucide React** only.
statement: In src/client/src/**, icons must come only from lucide-react; other icon libraries must not be imported.

quote: **Config:** Runtime config fetched from server at `/api/config` on bootstrap (not build-time env vars).
statement: In src/client/src/**, runtime configuration must come from the config fetched from /api/config (Config context), not from build-time env vars such as import.meta.env.

quote: **GraphQL:** Operations in `graphql/queries/` and `graphql/mutations/` as `gql` template literals. Codegen generates `__generated__/*.generated.tsx` files with typed Apollo hooks next to each operation file.
statement: In src/client/src/graphql/**, GraphQL operations must be defined as gql template literals in .ts files under graphql/queries/ or graphql/mutations/, and components should use the generated typed Apollo hooks from __generated__/*.generated.tsx.

quote: Schema is **code-first**: resolvers define it via NestJS/GraphQL decorators. `schema.gql` is auto-generated in dev mode.
statement: In src/server/**, the GraphQL schema must be defined code-first with NestJS GraphQL decorators (@Resolver, @Query, @Mutation, @ObjectType, @Field) rather than hand-written SDL.

quote: **Do not edit** `schema.gql` or `*.generated.tsx` — they are auto-generated.
statement: In the repository, schema.gql and src/client/src/graphql/**/__generated__/*.generated.tsx must not be edited by hand; they are regenerated by NestJS and npm run generate.

quote: Your service must implement `LightningProvider`. Use `LndService` (`src/server/modules/node/lnd/lnd.service.ts`) as a reference.
statement: In src/server/modules/node/<type>/, each Lightning provider service must implement the LightningProvider interface from lightning.types.ts.

quote: The `NodeService` looks up the correct provider for each account via `ProviderRegistryService` and delegates all calls to it. Resolvers never interact with providers directly.
statement: In src/server/modules/api/** resolvers, code must never import or call provider services (LndService, other LightningProvider implementations, ProviderRegistryService) directly; all calls go through NodeService.

quote: Create a new directory under `src/server/modules/node/`: src/server/modules/node/your-type/ ├── your-type.module.ts ├── your-type.service.ts └── your-type.helpers.ts (optional, for error handling etc.)
statement: In src/server/modules/node/, each provider must live in its own <type>/ directory containing <type>.module.ts, <type>.service.ts and optionally <type>.helpers.ts.

quote:
@Injectable()
export class YourTypeService implements LightningProvider {
statement: In src/server/modules/node/<type>/, provider service classes should be decorated with @Injectable() and exported from a NestJS @Module that lists them in providers and exports.

quote: Implement each method from the LightningProvider interface. The first parameter is always the connection object returned by connect().
statement: In src/server/modules/node/<type>/ provider services, every LightningProvider method must take the connection object returned by connect() as its first parameter.

In src/server/modules/node/<type>/ provider services, LightningProvider methods that are not supported must throw an Error (e.g. '<method> is not supported by <type>') and the matching capability must be omitted from getCapabilities().

quote: Return only the capabilities your implementation supports. The UI can query this to hide unsupported features.
statement: In src/server/modules/node/<type>/ provider services, getCapabilities() must return a Set<Capability> containing only the capabilities the provider actually implements.

quote: Within your service, type it concretely (e.g., `connection: AxiosInstance`)
statement: In src/server/modules/node/<type>/ provider services, the connection parameter should be typed with the concrete client type rather than any.

quote: If your implementation returns data in a different shape, map it in your service
statement: In src/server/modules/node/<type>/ provider services, return values must be mapped to the shapes the GraphQL resolvers expect (the lightning package's field names such as public_key, channels, tokens) inside the service, not in resolvers.

quote: In `src/server/modules/node/lightning.types.ts`, add your type to the `NodeType` object
statement: In src/server/modules/node/, every provider type must have a constant in the NodeType object in lightning.types.ts and be referenced via NodeType rather than string literals.

quote: In `src/server/modules/node/provider-registry.service.ts`, inject your service and register it
statement: In src/server/modules/node/provider-registry.service.ts and provider-registry.module.ts, every LightningProvider service must be injected and registered in ProviderRegistryService (this.providers.set(NodeType.X, service)) and its module imported in ProviderRegistryModule.

quote: If your implementation needs additional config fields, add them to `AccountType` and `UnresolvedAccountType` in `src/server/modules/files/files.types.ts`, and to `ParsedAccount` if they need to be passed through to the service.
statement: In src/server/modules/files/files.types.ts, account config fields must be declared on AccountType and UnresolvedAccountType (and ParsedAccount when passed to the service).

quote: "@typescript-eslint/interface-name-prefix": "off"
statement: In all linted TS/TSX files, interface names are not required to use (or avoid) an I prefix.

quote: "@typescript-eslint/explicit-function-return-type": "off"
statement: In all linted TS/TSX files, functions are not required to declare explicit return types.

quote: "@typescript-eslint/explicit-module-boundary-types": "off"
statement: In all linted TS/TSX files, exported functions are not required to declare explicit parameter and return types.

quote: "@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any": "off"
statement: In all linted TS/TSX files, use of the explicit `any` type is allowed (the recommended-preset rule is disabled).

quote: "@typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars": "error"
statement: In all linted TS/TSX files, code must not declare unused variables, parameters or imports.
